result.stdout:
Elwood — JSON transformation DSL

Usage:
  elwood                                    Start REPL
  elwood eval <expr> [options]              Evaluate expression
  elwood run <script.elwood> [options]      Execute script
  elwood pipeline run <yaml> [--source name=file ...]  Execute pipeline
  elwood pipeline validate <yaml>           Validate pipeline YAML

Options:
  --input <file>, -i        Input file (format auto-detected from extension)
  --json <json>, -j         Inline JSON input
  --input-format <fmt>, -if Override input format: json, csv, txt, xml, binary
  --output-format <fmt>, -of Convert output: csv, txt, xml

Examples:
  elwood eval "$.users[*] | where u => u.active" --input data.json
  elwood run transform.elwood --input data.csv
  elwood run transform.elwood --input data.json --output-format csv
  cat data.csv | elwood eval "$.fromCsv()" --input-format csv
  echo '{"x":1}' | elwood eval "$.x + 1"
